messages:
alice: FYI customer called our Refunds API via the integrations proxy, but instead of a refund we ended up with a credit note (credit_note.created). Customer upset. logs attached. anyone seen the router pick the wrong tool?

sam: can you paste the original payload and the tool_choice entry from the logs?

alice: payload snip: ```json
{
  \"action\": \"issue_refund\",
  \"order_id\": \"ORD-99321\",
  \"amount_cents\": 3400
}
```
log line: `tool_choice=note_creator, selected_handler_version=v2`

priya: hmm, proxy should map issue_refund -> refunds.v1.handle_refund. looks like the tool resolver matched by intent string 'credit' in some auxiliary metadata. do we have metadata on this request?

alice: header included x-caller-intent: "adjustment/credit" (customer integration), but they still sent action=issue_refund in body. maybe resolver weighted the header more.

mike: that header should be lower priority than explicit action. small repro attempt: I retried with same headers locally and saw the resolver pick note_creator 60% of the time if header present. seems like a scoring bug after recent model-change. :grimacing:

sam: linking to the resolver policy file: ```yaml
rules:
  - match: body.action == \"issue_refund\"
    weight: 100
  - match: headers.x-caller-intent contains \"credit\"
    weight: 30
```
If weights changed at runtime maybe header got boosted accidentally.

priya: @mike can you show the rollout flags? I think the model-based scorer was rolled out to 50% last night.

mike: deploy-bot: canary rollout of resolver-scorer v2 -> 50% at 2026-03-16T22:10Z.

mike: looks like v2 scoring gives header higher weight because of a bug in the feature vector normalization. I've queued a revert for canary.

alice: customer needs immediate fix/rollback or a manual reconciliation (issue refund and void credit note). what's the short-term mitigation?

sam: workaround: add explicit body.action mapping at gateway to force refunds handler for now: `force_handler=refunds.v1.handle_refund`. Can push a busybox patch to proxy in 5-10m.

priya: I'll open an escalation to SRE to apply the proxy patch and also flag all similar requests from the customer to avoid repeated credits.

alice: thanks. I'll tell customer we're applying a hotfix and manually processing the refund.

mike: reverting canary now, will monitor logs for misroutes. patch ID: revert-resolver-v2-20260316.

sam: follow-ups: 1) add an integration test for header+body precedence, 2) add telemetry alert when tool_choice != expected_handler for >0.5% of refund requests, 3) reconcile all affected transactions.

alice: noted. sending refund and follow-up steps to customer. :white_check_mark:

refunds-bot: reconciliation-ticket created: RCON-1420, assigned to @sam.

priya: closing this thread once revert is verified. ping me if any new misroutes show up. :mag:
